system.tactics: Wlkislons protect their herd and handlers first. They use Trample to break formations, then seize isolated targets with the trunk and finish them with Stomps. A Wlkislon does not pursue beyond the safety of its herd unless enraged or directed by a trusted handler.
system.attacksNotes:
Tusks [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 6 + Melee Combat 7), Reach: 15 ft

  • Margin 1:: 20 damage (12 + 8 Str)
  • Margin 2: 20 damage, DR halved (round up); target is pushed 10 ft

Trunk Slam [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 6 + Melee Combat 7), Reach: 10 ft

  • Margin 1:: 16 damage (8 + 8 Str)
  • Margin 2: 16 damage, DR halved (round up); target is Grappled

Stomp [Combat]: Melee attack against a Prone or Grappled creature in an adjacent space (Agil 3 + Melee Combat 6)

  • Margin 1:: 20 damage (12 + 8 Str)
  • Margin 2: 20 damage, DR halved (round up)

Multiattack [Combat]: The Wlkislon makes one Tusks attack and one Trunk Slam attack, or one Stomp attack against a qualifying target. Shared Attribute Roll (Agil 3): Roll Agility once and apply it to both ### Attacks.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Powerful Build: The Wlkislon counts as Gargantuan for carrying, pushing, dragging, and lifting. Trample (Recharge 5-8) [Combat]: The Wlkislon moves up to its speed in a straight line. Each creature in its path makes a Reflex save opposed by the Wlkislon's Str 8 + Athletics 7. On a loss, the creature takes 16 bludgeoning damage and is knocked Prone; on a success, it takes 8 damage and may move 5 feet aside. A creature can be targeted only once per Trample. Memory of the Herd: The Wlkislon has Fortune on saves against Frightened while another Wlkislon is within 60 feet. Siege Beast: The Wlkislon deals double damage to unattended structures, vehicles, and vessels. Desription The Welkislon is a siege-scale mount and working beast. It counts as Gargantuan for carrying, pushing, dragging, and lifting. A trained Wlkislon can carry a howdah or platform with several riders, but it acts on the rider or handler's initiative only when specially trained; otherwise it has its own turn and cannot be directed in combat by an untrained rider. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
